title: Seize the Relic
description: A priceless relic lies amid the ruins. Both sides rush to claim it, hoping its secrets or symbolism will turn the tide of war.
setup: Place a Relic marker at the exact center of the Battlefield.
deployment:
- Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
- Roll off; winner chooses their edge.
victory: At the end of each Turn, the Squad controlling the Relic scores 1 MP. At the end of the game, the Squad in control of the Relic scores 3 MP.

title: Twin Uplinks
description: Vital data uplinks are still active on this battlefield. Securing them will grant command of local fire support and intelligence.
setup: Place 2 Console markers on the midline, each 6 Squares from the center.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
special:
**Activate Console (2 ACT):**  
A Unit that is Adjacent to a Console may Activate it for 2 ACT. A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
victory: At the end of each Turn, each Squad scores 1 MP for each Console they control.

title: Secure the Shrine
description: A sacred site or symbol of power must be claimed before it falls into enemy hands.
setup: Place a Shrine marker at the center of the Defender's Deployment Zone.
deployment:
- Defender deploys within their Deployment Zone around the Shrine.
- Attacker deploys within the opposite edge.
victory: At the end of the game, the Squad controlling the Shrine scores 5 MP.

title: Dominate the Center
description: The heart of the battlefield is the key to victory. Whoever holds the center will hold the advantage.
setup: Mark the central Tile of the Battlefield.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
victory: At the end of each Turn, the Squad controlling the central Tile scores 1 MP. At the end of the game, the Squad controlling the central Tile scores 2 additional MP.

title: Breakthrough
description: Speed and aggression are vital. The enemy lines must be pierced, no matter the cost.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
victory: At the end of the game, each Unit fully within the opponent's Deployment Zone scores 1 MP for its Squad. The Squad with the most Units across the line gains an additional 2 MP.

title: Hold the Line
description: The enemy surges forward, but the position must not be broken. Every step back is a step toward defeat.
deployment:
- Defender deploys within their Deployment Zone.
- Attacker deploys within the opposite edge.
victory: At the end of the game, the Defender scores 1 MP for each Unit fully within their Deployment Zone. The Attacker scores 1 MP for each Unit fully within the Defender's Deployment Zone.

title: Assassinate the Leader
description: The enemy's chain of command is vulnerable. Strike down their leader and the battle will collapse into chaos.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
victory: A Squad scores 3 MP if the opposing Leader is destroyed. If both Leaders survive, no MP are awarded.

title: Marked for Death
description: Certain enemy combatants have been identified as high-value targets. Eliminate them before they eliminate you.
setup: Each player secretly marks one enemy Unit before deployment begins.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
victory: A Squad scores 3 MP if the marked enemy Unit is destroyed. If both marked Units are destroyed, each Squad scores 2 MP.

title: Cull the Swarm
description: Only by thinning the enemy's ranks can the field be secured. Numbers mean nothing if they are reduced to corpses.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
victory: A Squad scores 1 MP for every 2 enemy Units destroyed.

title: Bounty Hunt
description: A valuable prize has been identified among the enemy's ranks. Destroy them and claim the reward.
setup: After deployment, the opponent nominates one of their Units to be marked with a Bounty token.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
victory: Destroying the Bounty Unit scores 5 MP.

title: Duel of Champions
description: Honor or desperation has demanded a duel between chosen warriors. The battle is decided by their fate.
setup: Each Squad nominates one Champion Unit before deployment.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
victory: A Squad scores 3 MP if the enemy Champion is destroyed. If both Champions are destroyed, each Squad scores 2 MP.

title: Rescue the Prisoner
description: A captive Unit is held under guard. One Squad seeks to free them, the other to keep them bound.
setup: Place a Prisoner marker at the center of the Battlefield.
deployment:
- Defender deploys within their Deployment Zone.
- Attacker deploys on the opposite edge.
special:
**Free Prisoner (1 ACT):**  
A Unit Adjacent to the Prisoner may take control of them. Once freed, the Prisoner is carried and moves with that Unit.
victory: Attacker scores 5 MP if the Prisoner is escorted into their Deployment Zone by game end. Defender scores 5 MP if the Prisoner is not freed.

title: Recover the Data Cores
description: Fragments of battlefield data are scattered across the ruins. Both sides rush to secure the information before it is lost or stolen.
setup: Place 3 Data Core markers along the midline, each at least 5 Squares apart.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
special:
**Recover Data Core (1 ACT):**  
A Unit Adjacent to a Data Core may pick it up. A Unit may only carry one Data Core at a time.
victory: A Squad scores 1 MP for each Data Core carried into their Deployment Zone. If a Unit carrying a Data Core is destroyed, the Core is dropped in its Square.

title: Loot and Salvage
description: Supplies and valuable materiel lie abandoned. Only those bold enough to carry them out will profit from this warzone.
setup: Scatter 5 Resource markers across the central Tiles. No marker may be placed within 4 Squares of another.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
special:
**Collect Resource (1 ACT):**  
A Unit Adjacent to a Resource may pick it up. A Unit may carry up to 2 Resources.
victory: At the end of the game, each Squad scores 1 MP for each Resource their Units are carrying.

title: Search & Scan
description: Hidden signals emanate from the battlefield. Locating and decoding them may change the course of the war.
setup: Place 3 Scan markers: one at the center, and one in each neutral corner Tile (not adjacent to deployment zones).
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
special:
**Scan Marker (2 ACT):**  
A Unit Adjacent to a Scan marker may Scan it for 2 ACT. A marker can only be Scanned once per Squad.
victory: Each successfully Scanned marker is worth 1 MP to the Squad that scanned it.

title: Rescue the Survivor
description: A lone survivor has vital knowledge. One Squad races to extract them, while the other seeks to prevent their escape.
setup: Place a Survivor token in the central Tile, within 2 Squares of the center.
deployment:
- Defender deploys within their Deployment Zone.
- Attacker deploys within the opposite edge.
special:
**Rescue Survivor (1 ACT):**  
A Unit Adjacent to the Survivor may claim them. The Survivor moves with that Unit as a carried token.
victory: The Attacker scores 5 MP if the Survivor is carried into their Deployment Zone by game end. The Defender scores 5 MP if the Survivor is not extracted.

title: Secure the Intel
description: Enemy command has hidden critical information within a fortified position. Whoever holds it will hold the future of the conflict.
setup: Place a Data Vault marker in the ruins or a building in the central Tile.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
special:
**Hack Vault (2 ACT):**  
A Unit Adjacent to the Vault may attempt to hack it for 2 ACT. On a roll of 1–4, the hack is successful for that Squad.
victory: Each successful hack scores 2 MP. Controlling the Vault at game end scores an additional 2 MP.

title: Capture the Comm Array
description: A comms uplink provides control over local fire missions. One side must take control; the other must defend it at all costs.
setup: Place a Comm Array marker at the center of the Defender's Deployment Zone.
deployment:
- Defender deploys within their Deployment Zone around the Comm Array.
- Attacker deploys on the opposite edge.
special:
**Activate Array (2 ACT):**  
A Unit Adjacent to the Comm Array may Activate it for 2 ACT. Once Activated, it counts as controlled by that Squad until an enemy Activates it.
victory: The Attacker scores 5 MP if they control the Comm Array at the end of the game. The Defender scores 5 MP if they control it or if it remains inactive.

title: Demolitions
description: Enemy fortifications block the path forward. They must be destroyed before reinforcements arrive.
setup: Place 3 Structure markers along the midline, each at least 5 Squares apart.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
special: Each Structure has `ARM` **3** and `HIT` **4**. Structures may be targeted by Attacks.
victory: The Attacker scores 1 MP for each Structure destroyed. The Defender scores 1 MP for each Structure remaining intact at game end.

title: Sabotage the Generator
description: A massive generator powers the enemy war effort. If destroyed, the enemy will be crippled.
setup: Place a Generator marker in the center of the Defender's Deployment Zone.
deployment:
- Defender deploys within their Deployment Zone around the Generator.
- Attacker deploys within the opposite edge.
special: The Generator has `ARM` **4** and `HIT` **6**. It may be targeted by Attacks as if it were a Unit.
victory: The Attacker scores 5 MP if the Generator is destroyed. The Defender scores 5 MP if the Generator remains intact at the end of the game.

title: Burn the Supplies
description: Vital supplies lie ahead. If they cannot be secured, they must be destroyed.
setup: Place 3 Supply Cache markers evenly across the midline.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
special:
**Destroy Cache (2 ACT):**  
A Unit Adjacent to a Cache may destroy it for 2 ACT. The Cache is then removed from play.
victory: The Attacker scores 1 MP for each Cache destroyed. The Defender scores 1 MP for each Cache remaining at game end.

title: Collapse the Tunnel
description: An underground passage offers the enemy mobility and supply. Destroying the tunnel will cut them off permanently.
setup: Place a Tunnel marker along the midline, touching one battlefield edge.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
special: The Tunnel has `ARM` **2** and `HIT` **5**. It may be targeted by Attacks.
victory: The Attacker scores 5 MP if the Tunnel is destroyed. The Defender scores 5 MP if it remains intact at the end of the game.

title: Ritual Interruption
description: The enemy is conducting a ritual that must be stopped before it is complete.
setup: Place a Ritual Site marker in the center of the Defender's Deployment Zone.
deployment:
- Defender deploys within their Deployment Zone around the Site.
- Attacker deploys on the opposite edge.
special:
**Disrupt Ritual (2 ACT):**  
A Unit Adjacent to the Ritual Site may attempt to disrupt it for 2 ACT. On a roll of 1–4, the ritual is disrupted.
victory: The Attacker scores 5 MP if the Ritual Site is disrupted by Turn 5. The Defender scores 5 MP if the Site is not disrupted by then.

title: Shatter the Idol
description: A massive idol stands as a symbol of defiance. Destroying it will shatter the enemy's spirit.
setup: Place an Idol marker in the center of the Defender's Deployment Zone.
deployment:
- Defender deploys within their Deployment Zone around the Idol.
- Attacker deploys within the opposite edge.
special: The Idol has `ARM` **4** and `HIT` **8**. It may be targeted by Attacks as if it were a Unit.
victory: The Attacker scores 5 MP if the Idol is destroyed. The Defender scores 5 MP if the Idol remains intact at the end of the game.

title: Escort the Convoy
description: A vital transport must cross the warzone intact. One Squad is charged with guiding it through, while the other prepares the ambush.
setup: Place a Convoy marker (40mm token or miniature) in the Attacker's Deployment Zone.
deployment:
- Defender deploys first within their Deployment Zone.
- Attacker deploys second within their Deployment Zone.
special: The Convoy moves 4 Paces during the Attacker's Movement phase if at least one friendly Unit is Adjacent. If not, it does not move.
victory: The Attacker scores 5 MP if the Convoy exits via the Defender's battlefield edge. The Defender scores 1 MP at the end of each Turn the Convoy has not exited by Turn 6.

title: Extraction
description: A valuable target must be pulled out before the enemy can close in. The extraction zone is hot, and time is short.
setup: Place a VIP marker at the center of the Battlefield.
deployment:
- Defender deploys within their Deployment Zone.
- Attacker deploys on the opposite edge.
special:
**Secure VIP (1 ACT):**  
A Unit Adjacent to the VIP may claim them. The VIP moves with that Unit as a carried token.
victory: The Attacker scores 5 MP if the VIP is carried into their Deployment Zone by game end. The Defender scores 5 MP if the VIP is not extracted.

title: Protect the Asset
description: A vital piece of materiel or intelligence is under attack. One side must protect it; the other seeks to destroy it.
setup: Place an Asset marker in the center of the Defender's Deployment Zone.
deployment:
- Defender deploys within their Deployment Zone around the Asset.
- Attacker deploys on the opposite edge.
special: The Asset has `ARM` **4** and `HIT` **6**. It may be targeted by Attacks.
victory: The Attacker scores 5 MP if the Asset is destroyed. The Defender scores 5 MP if the Asset remains intact at the end of the game.

title: Hostage Negotiation
description: Terrified civilians are caught between firelines. Both sides seek to secure and evacuate them before it is too late.
setup: Place 3 Civilian markers along the midline, each at least 4 Squares apart.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
special:
**Secure Civilian (1 ACT):**  
A Unit Adjacent to a Civilian may claim them. A Civilian moves with that Unit as a carried token.
victory: Each Civilian carried into a Squad's Deployment Zone scores 2 MP for that Squad.

title: Ambush
description: One Squad has been caught in hostile territory. They must survive the trap long enough to regroup or escape.
deployment:
- Defender deploys all Units in the central Tile.
- Attacker deploys all Units within 2 Tiles along opposite board edges.
victory: The Attacker scores 1 MP for each Defender Unit destroyed. The Defender scores 1 MP for each of their Units surviving at the end of the game.

title: Breakout
description: Surrounded on all sides, the only hope is to punch through enemy lines.
deployment:
- One Squad deploys in the central Tile.
- The opposing Squad deploys Units split between all four board edges.
victory: The surrounded Squad scores 1 MP for each Unit that exits fully through any battlefield edge. The encircling Squad scores 1 MP for each Unit destroyed.

title: Survival
description: Against overwhelming odds, only endurance will determine victory. One side seeks to wipe the field clean; the other seeks to endure.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
victory: Each Unit surviving at the end of the game is worth 1 MP to its Squad.

title: Stalling Action
description: One force has orders to delay the enemy advance until reinforcements arrive. Every minute bought is a victory.
deployment:
- Defender deploys within their Deployment Zone.
- Attacker deploys on the opposite edge.
victory: The Defender scores 1 MP for each Turn that at least one of their Units remains on the Battlefield. The Attacker scores 1 MP for each Defender Unit destroyed.

title: Last Stand
description: The situation is hopeless, but retreat is not an option. The defenders must make every life count before they are overwhelmed.
deployment:
- Defender deploys with half as many Units as the Attacker, within their Deployment Zone.
- Attacker deploys on the opposite edge.
victory: The Defender scores 1 MP for each Turn they still have at least one Unit on the Battlefield. The Attacker scores 1 MP for each Defender Unit destroyed.

title: Sudden Assault
description: There is little time before the area is engulfed in fire. A swift strike will decide the battle.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
special: This mission lasts only 4 Turns.
victory: At the end of Turn 4, each Squad scores 1 MP for each objective marker controlled (if any are in play) and 1 MP for each 2 enemy Units destroyed.

title: Deny the Field
description: The enemy must not be allowed to control any part of the field. Push them back and leave nothing in their grasp.
setup: Place 3 Objective markers evenly along the midline.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
victory: At the end of each Turn, if a Squad controls all Objective markers, they score 2 MP. If neither Squad controls them all, no MP are awarded.

title: Escalation
description: Reinforcements and critical objectives arrive mid-battle. Control shifts constantly as the fight drags on.
setup: No objectives are placed at the start of the game.
deployment: - Both Squads deploy within their Deployment Zones on opposite edges.
special: At the start of Turn 2 and each Turn after, place 1 new Objective marker at the center of a random neutral Tile.
victory: At the end of each Turn, each controlled Objective scores 1 MP for the controlling Squad.
